The role of nutrition in inﬂammatory bowel disease


A large subgroup (n ¼ 39,511) of women from this cohort who also completed a retrospective validated food frequency ques-
tionnaire (FFQ) recalling intake from their high school years was examined. A trend for women in the highest quartile of ﬁber intake
to be less likely to develop CD than women in the lowest quartile (26.2 vs. 16.8 g ﬁber per day, p ¼ 0.06) was identiﬁed. When
